content_of_post_to_comment: told a tech entrepreneur girl at my public speaking practice club “btw most people can't tell but if you're raising you shouldn't let ai write copy for your slides” and she was like “wtf how did you know??” and I was like “you used claude right” and she was like “omg yes you can tell???” doing my part in the fight against the slopocalypse
comment: The interesting line isn't just that AI has a detectable voice, but that slide copy exposes the gap between borrowed fluency and lived understanding. Maybe the next skill is editing AI until it sounds like your own thinking.
